将文件拖到此处，或从电脑选择文件。: Drop a file here or choose one from your computer.
留空使用全部页面。可按你输入的顺序导出。: Leave blank to use all pages. Pages are exported in the order entered.
选择输出目录后，每组页面会保存为单独的 PDF。: Each group is saved as a separate PDF in the selected folder.
按列表顺序把多份 PDF 合成一份。: Combine PDFs in the order listed.
按固定页数把一份 PDF 分成多个文件。: Split a PDF into files with a fixed number of pages.
把选中的页面导出为一份新 PDF。: Export selected pages to a new PDF.
按指定顺序排列页面，可删除不需要的页或旋转导出的页。: Reorder, remove, or rotate pages in the exported PDF.
选择输出格式，转换全部或指定页面。: Choose an output format and convert all or selected pages.
按列表顺序把图片合成一份 PDF，每张图片一页。: Combine images in the order listed, one image per page.
通过本机安装的 LibreOffice 将文档导出为 PDF。: Export documents to PDF using your local LibreOffice installation.
Word、Excel、PowerPoint、OpenDocument、RTF、T: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF, TXT
页面改动尚未另存。要放弃改动吗？: Page edits are unsaved. Discard changes?

选择文件或拖到此处: Choose a file or drop it here

请先打开要打印的 PDF。: Open a PDF to print first.

无法准备打印页面。: Could not prepare the page for printing.

每页一张 PNG，文件名保留原始页码。: One PNG per page. Filenames retain the original page numbers.
将页面按顺序纵向拼接为一张 PNG。: Stack pages vertically in order to create a single PNG.
保留页面尺寸和外观，文字无法搜索或复制。: Preserves page size and appearance. Text cannot be searched or copied.
每页作为一张图片放入幻灯片，文字和图形不单独编辑。: Each page becomes a slide image. Text and graphics cannot be edited individually.
提取 PDF 内已有的文字。图片、表格结构和原排版不保留，扫描件需要 OCR。: Extracts existing PDF text. Images, table structure, and original layout are omitted. Scans require OCR.

请输入要导出的页码，例如 2 或 1-3, 5。: Enter the pages to export, e.g. 2 or 1-3, 5.
输入单个页码或页码范围，每个页面只导出一次。: Enter page numbers or ranges. Each page is exported once.
